''See also: [[Tiberian Arelius Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Tiberian [[Arelius family|Arelius]], also known as the [[Storm King]], was a powerful [[Monarch]] and the [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]] of [[Arelius family|House Arelius]]. He once ruled over much of the [[Rosegold continent]], ushering in an era of prosperity and maintaining a delicate peace with his neighbor, [[House Shen]]. Known for his polished fighting style and mastery of spiritual attacks involving lightning, he was a highly skilled combatant who utilized techniques such as the [[True Storm Hammer]] and the [[Pure Storm Baptism]], a process designed to repair soul damage. Tiberian's reign was marked by an ambitious and ultimately catastrophic attempt to eliminate the [[Dreadgods]]. Influenced by his advisors, he proposed an alliance with [[Reigan Shen]] to pursue this goal, leading to the [[Dread War]]. This conflict resulted in a massive battle between [[Monarchs]] that devastated much of the [[Rosegold continent]] and led to Tiberian's death. His legacy includes various research into storms and soul restoration, as well as the [[Dawn Sky Palace]], a beautiful [[pocket world]] that once belonged to his wife. Although he is deceased, his influence persists through his descendants and the various branches of the [[Arelius family|Arelius clan]] spread across different continents.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Tiberian is a man with short blond hair and a beard hewn from lightning. His blue eyes feature crackling electricity behind them.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As the [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]] of [[Arelius family|House Arelius]], he served as a [[Monarch]] and an advisor to [[Eithan]]. He was driven by a dream to rid the world of the [[Dreadgods]] and have them ascend.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A spearman, he utilizes [[madra]] that shifts between a fluid river, a powerful gust, and a devastating thunderbolt. His techniques include the [[Pure Storm Baptism]], an [[Enforcer technique]] involving three-colored lightning, and a bloodline ability that allows him to move as if he has seen a fight in advance.}}
